items.source:
In the following, "field" represents the path in JSON deduced from the part of the method name. "a" and "b" represent the values of next consumed method parameters. "array" represent a JsonArray constructed from the next method parameter value (if a collection or array, contained values are used to fill the array, otherwise it's a single item array).

items.source: NOT_IN: field NOT IN array - note that the next parameter value (or its children if a collection/array) should be compatible for storage in a JsonArray)
items.translation: NOT_IN： 字段不在数组中——请注意，下一个参数值（如果是集合/数组，则为其子元素）应兼容存储于JsonArray中。

items.source: IN: field IN array - note that the next parameter value (or its children if a collection/array) should be compatible for storage in a JsonArray)
items.translation: IN： 数组中的字段——请注意，下一个参数值（如果是集合/数组，则为其子元素）应兼容存储于JsonArray中。

items.source: BETWEEN: field BETWEEN a AND b
items.translation: BETWEEN: 字段介于 a 和 b 之间

items.source: IS_NOT_NULL: field IS NOT NULL
items.translation: IS_NOT_NULL：字段不为空

items.source: IS_NULL: field IS NULL
items.translation: IS_NULL：字段为 NULL

items.source: NOT_LIKE: field NOT LIKE "a" - a should be a String containing % and _ (matching n and 1 characters)
items.translation: NOT_LIKE： 字段 NOT LIKE "a" - a 应是一个包含 % 和 _（分别匹配任意多个字符和单个字符）的字符串。

items.source: LIKE: field LIKE "a" - a should be a String containing % and _ (matching n and 1 characters)
items.translation: LIKE： field LIKE "a" - a 应为一个包含 % 和 _（分别匹配任意长度字符和单个字符）的字符串。

items.source: STARTING_WITH: field LIKE "a%" - a should be a String prefix
items.translation: STARTING_WITH: 字段 LIKE "a%" - a 应为一个字符串前缀

items.source: ENDING_WITH: field LIKE "%a" - a should be a String suffix
items.translation: ENDING_WITH: 字段 LIKE "%a" - a 应为字符串后缀

items.source: NOT_CONTAINING: field NOT LIKE "%a%" - a should be a String
items.translation: NOT_CONTAINING： 字段不包含"%a%" - a 应为字符串

items.source: CONTAINING: field LIKE "%a%" - a should be a String
items.translation: 包含：字段 LIKE "%a%" - a 应为字符串

items.source: REGEX: REGEXP_LIKE(field, "a") - note that the ignoreCase is ignored here, a is a regular expression in String form
items.translation: REGEX: REGEXP_LIKE(field, "a") - 请注意，此处忽略大小写选项被忽略，"a" 是字符串形式的正则表达式。

items.source: EXISTS: field IS NOT MISSING - used to verify that the JSON contains this attribute
items.translation: EXISTS： 字段未缺失——用于验证 JSON 是否包含该属性。

items.source: NEAR, WITHIN: geospatial is not supported in N1QL as of now
items.translation: NEAR，WITHIN： 目前 N1QL 不支持地理空间功能。

items.source: Simon Baslé, Subhashni Balakrishnan, Mark Paluch
items.translation: 西蒙·巴斯拉，苏巴斯尼·巴拉克里希南，马克·帕卢奇

items.source: This Query Creator is responsible for parsing a PartTree (representing a method name) into the WHERE clause of a N1QL query.
items.translation: 该 Query Creator 负责将一个 PartTree（代表方法名）解析为 N1QL 查询的 WHERE 子句。

items.source:
• BETWEEN: 字段介于 a 和 b 之间
  • IS_NOT_NULL：字段不为空
  • IS_NULL：字段为 NULL
  • NEGATING_SIMPLE_PROPERTY: - field != a
  • SIMPLE_PROPERTY: - field = a
  • LESS_THAN: field < a
  • LESS_THAN_EQUAL: field <= a
  • GREATER_THAN_EQUAL: field >= a
  • GREATER_THAN: field > a
  • BEFORE: field < a
  • AFTER: field > a
  • NOT_LIKE： 字段 NOT LIKE "a" - a 应是一个包含 % 和 _（分别匹配任意多个字符和单个字符）的字符串。
  • LIKE： field LIKE "a" - a 应为一个包含 % 和 _（分别匹配任意长度字符和单个字符）的字符串。
  • STARTING_WITH: 字段 LIKE "a%" - a 应为一个字符串前缀
  • ENDING_WITH: 字段 LIKE "%a" - a 应为字符串后缀
  • NOT_CONTAINING： 字段不包含"%a%" - a 应为字符串
  • 包含：字段 LIKE "%a%" - a 应为字符串
  • NOT_IN： 字段不在数组中——请注意，下一个参数值（如果是集合/数组，则为其子元素）应兼容存储于JsonArray中。
  • IN： 数组中的字段——请注意，下一个参数值（如果是集合/数组，则为其子元素）应兼容存储于JsonArray中。
  • TRUE: field = TRUE
  • FALSE: field = FALSE
  • REGEX: REGEXP_LIKE(field, "a") - 请注意，此处忽略大小写选项被忽略，"a" 是字符串形式的正则表达式。
  • EXISTS： 字段未缺失——用于验证 JSON 是否包含该属性。

The following are not supported and will throw an IllegalArgumentException if encountered:
  • NEAR，WITHIN： 目前 N1QL 不支持地理空间功能。
